name: BMW VENTURES LIMITED
summary: BMW Ventures Limited engages in the trading and distribution of long and flat steel products in Bihar, India. The company offers thermo mechanically treated bars and galvanized wires, and structura - rectangular, square, and circular steel hollow sections; flat steel products, including galvanized corrugated sheets, galvanized sheets, hot rolled sheets and coils, and cold rolled sheets and coils; agrico tools, such as hoes, shovels, sickles, crowbars, pickaxes, and hammers. It also distributes John Deer tractor engines and spare parts; manufactures and sells polyvinyl chlorid pipes under BMW Polytube brand label; and rents construction equipment, as well as fabricates pre-engineered building and steel girders, and provides roll forming for galvanized plain sheets. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Patna, India.
